refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns an associative array with the following elements:
Key Value description
version_number cURL 24 bit version number
version cURL version number, as a string
ssl_version_number Always 0, libcurl does not set it anymore
ssl_version OpenSSL version number, as a string
libz_version zlib version number, as a string
host Information about the host where cURL was built
age
The age of the version info returned by libcurl. Newer libcurl versions have a higher age
features A bitmask of the CURL_VERSION_* constants
protocols An array of protocols names supported by cURL
feature_list
An associative array of all known cURL features, and whether they are supported (&true;) or not (&false;)
ares c-ares version, as a string, or an empty string if cURL was built without c-ares
ares_num c-ares version number, or 0 if cURL was built without c-ares
libidn libidn2 version, as a string, or an empty string if cURL was built without libidn2
iconv_ver_num iconv version number, or 0 if cURL was built without iconv
libssh_version SSH library name and version, as a string, or an empty string if cURL was built without SSH support
brotli_ver_num Brotli version number, or 0 if cURL was built without Brotli
brotli_version Brotli version, as a string, or an empty string if cURL was built without Brotli
